title: SOP for Analysis of Benoxacor in Subcellular Fractions by GC-MS/ECD
author: Derek Simonsen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bb52iq8e

steps.title: Label Tubes and Vials
steps.instruction: Label disposable culture tubes and GC vials using unique sample numbers including initials and experiment identifiers (e.g., notebook number).

substeps.instruction: Label tubes for QA/QC samples: buffer, cofactor without benoxacor, inactivated subcellular fractions, subcellular fractions without c-substrate, and DMSO spiked buffer with cofactor.
Label tubes for experimental samples.
Label one tube for the Reference Standard (containing known amounts of all analytes, surrogate recovery standards, and internal standard).
Label at least one tube for method blanks (buffer only).
Label at least one tube per sample blank (matrix samples from species/sex analyzed).
Label three tubes for Ongoing Precision and Recovery (OPR) samples (matrix samples spiked with known amounts of benoxacor).
Label tubes for all other samples (recommended 20% QA/QC samples; increase blank samples accordingly).

steps.title: Heat and Cool Samples
steps.instruction: Immediately after incubation, heat samples in a furnace and then cool.

substeps.instruction: Place samples in furnace for 10 minutes at 110 °C (do not exceed 10 minutes to avoid reducing analyte recovery).
Cool samples to room temperature.

steps.title: Perform First Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract analytes from the samples using ethyl acetate and KCl.

substeps.instruction: Spike samples with 25 μL of 20 μg/mL trifluralin dissolved in ethyl acetate.
Add 2 mL pesticide grade ethyl acetate to all samples (do not add extra ethyl acetate to the reference standard).
Mix on a tube rotator for 1 minute at 40 rpm with tight caps to prevent leaking.
Centrifuge at 3,000 rpm (1811 x g) for 5 minutes to facilitate phase separation.
Add 2 mL of 1% KCl to the 4 mL of ethyl acetate to remove residual proteins.
Mix on a tube rotator.
Centrifuge at 3,000 rpm (1811 x g) for 5 minutes to facilitate phase separation.
Transfer 2 mL of the ethyl acetate layer into a clean culture tube.

steps.title: Perform Second Extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction process to maximize recovery.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the spiking, adding ethyl acetate, mixing, centrifuging, adding KCl, mixing, and centrifuging steps from the first extraction.
Combine the 2 mL of ethyl acetate from this second extraction with the 2 mL from the first extraction.

steps.title: Dry and Purify Extract
steps.instruction: Remove moisture and impurities from the combined ethyl acetate extract.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the 4 mL of combined ethyl acetate to a clean culture tube containing 0.25 mg of magnesium sulfate.
Centrifuge at 3,000 rpm (1811 x g) for 5 minutes to precipitate magnesium sulfate.
Carefully transfer the ethyl acetate into a clean tube, avoiding the transfer of magnesium sulfate.
Spike each tube with 25 μL of 20 μg/mL acenaphthene.
Evaporate each tube under nitrogen to approximately 500 μL.
Transfer samples into a GC vial and dilute to 1 mL.

steps.title: Analyze via GC-MS
steps.instruction: Run samples using GC-MS with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Injection: Splitless at 280 °C.
Column: Supelco SLB-5MS (30 m length, 0.25 mm ID, 0.25 µm film thickness).
Helium flow rate: 1 mL/min.
Oven Program: 50 °C (hold 1 min) $ightarrow$ 15 °C/min to 240 °C (hold 13 min) $ightarrow$ 15 °C/min to 300 °C (hold 10 min).
MS Temperatures: Source 230 °C, Quad 150 °C.
Monitored Ions (SIM Mode): Acenaphthene (RT 11.35, ions 153, 154), Trifluralin (RT 12.74, ions 264, 306), Benoxacor (RT 15.57, ions 120, 259).

steps.title: Analyze via GC-ECD
steps.instruction: Run samples using GC-ECD to determine the enantiomeric fraction of benoxacor:

substeps.instruction: Detector: 63 Ni-µECD.
Column: Agilent CP-Chrialsil Dex CB (25 m length, 0.25 mm ID, 0.25 µm film thickness).
Injector Temperature: 250 °C.
Helium flow rate: 2 mL/min (constant).
Oven Program: 50 °C (hold 1 min) $ightarrow$ 10 °C/min to 145 °C (hold 50 min) $ightarrow$ 15 °C/min to 200 °C (hold 12 min).
